TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: La Narrativa de la Solidaridad y la Igualdad
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: Este año, te convertirás en alguien que construye una comunidad sólida con colegas confiables.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body:
La narrativa central que recorre tu año no es un viaje solitario, sino la formación de un equipo sólido con personas que comparten tus metas. Te liberarás del peso que cargabas a solas y crearás alianzas horizontales que reconocen las fortalezas de cada uno.

A través de este proceso, dejarás atrás la presión de liderar a otros y aprenderás la alegría de caminar lado a lado. La sinergia que se crea cuando personas que han dado lo mejor de sí en su propio lugar se encuentran es mucho más grande y cálida de lo que imaginas.

El marco de solidaridad honesta que construyas a lo largo del año se convertirá en la cerca más fuerte que apoya tu vida. Apóyate en los hombros del otro y disfruta de un verdadero sentido de pertenencia y estabilidad.

Será un tiempo valioso para darte cuenta de que llegar lejos juntos suele ser más valioso que ir rápido solo. Te animo a trazar una trayectoria de crecimiento brillante con las conexiones preciosas a tu lado.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.watch_for: Perder tu color único y tu subjetividad al dejarte arrastrar por la atmósfera del grupo.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Construir una red de colegas centrales a largo plazo que respete la autonomía de cada uno.

TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: Construyendo el Futuro Juntos
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: Este año, te convertirás en un líder de la solidaridad que expande las metas personales hacia la sinergia colectiva.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body:
Este es el año para establecer un hito enorme con compañeros que se apoyan mutuamente en igualdad de condiciones. La calidez y autenticidad dentro de ti atraerán naturalmente a quienes te rodean y formarán una fuerza motriz enorme.

Experimentarás la alegría de logros notables al compartir tareas a largo plazo que no te atrevías a hacer solo. A medida que completen las deficiencias del otro e intercambien inspiración, tu perspectiva se ampliará aún más.

Durante este tiempo, compartir generosamente tu conocimiento y tu corazón se convierte en un atajo para elevar tu valor. El tiempo dedicado a reír y compartir preocupaciones con quienes te rodean se acumulará como tu activo más brillante.

Un futuro construido juntos más allá del poder individual te da una emoción que hace latir el corazón. Abre tu corazón, extiende tu mano y da un paso poderoso hacia el éxito compartido.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.watch_for: Comprometer tus valores centrales con demasiada facilidad para evitar fricciones con quienes te rodean.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Perseguir proyectos colaborativos a largo plazo con personas que comparten una visión común.

TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: Estableciendo una Presencia Igualitaria
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: A lo largo de este año, te convertirás en el centro de alianzas horizontales que intercambian una confianza profunda.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body:
Este es el año en que se completa una red de relaciones sana e igualitaria, donde puedes caminar lado a lado en cada espacio de tu vida. Renacerás como una persona experta que establece su presencia mientras reconoce de buen grado la autonomía de los demás.

Dominarás profundamente cómo comunicarte en completa igualdad, rompiendo con las relaciones jerárquicas o las estructuras competitivas. Como resultado, desaparecen los malentendidos innecesarios y el agotador consumo emocional, reduciendo enormemente la fatiga de las relaciones.

Las relaciones firmemente conectadas por una confianza profunda sin restringirse mutuamente son el tesoro más valioso que puedes ganar este año. Comparte conversaciones sinceras con quienes permanecen a tu lado y consolida los vínculos de sus corazones.

La confianza mutua acumulada a lo largo del año aporta una enorme paz y orgullo a tu vida. Espero que disfrutes plenamente de la verdadera felicidad que florece en las relaciones equilibradas.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.watch_for: Sentir una impaciencia innecesaria al comparar tu velocidad de crecimiento con la de los demás.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Invertir profundamente en relaciones igualitarias y honestas que se inspiren mutuamente.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: El Filo Afilado
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: Este año, serás entrenado hasta convertirte en un amo abrumador de la habilidad, inquebrantable ante cualquier estímulo externo.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body:
Este año se convierte en un poderoso campo de entrenamiento donde la competencia feroz y los estímulos externos despiertan tu potencial oculto. Una fuerte voluntad de superar los límites anteriores florece completamente dentro de ti, abriendo un dominio único.

Los cambios rápidos o los entornos desafiantes a tu alrededor pueden sentirse abrumadores al principio, pero pronto se convierten en nutrientes que te hacen aún más fuerte. Experimentarás un crecimiento brillante al verificar objetivamente tus habilidades y llenar los vacíos.

Al final del año, habiendo atravesado voluntariamente los feroces dolores del crecimiento, te erguirás como un árbol fuerte que nadie puede reemplazar. Disfruta de la emoción de demostrarte únicamente a través de tus habilidades, sin dejarte sacudir por el ruido externo.

Adopta la mentalidad de afilar una hoja más dura cada vez que enfrentes una prueba. La ferocidad de este año se convertirá en tu mejor arma para hacerte brillar más en el día lejano.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.watch_for: Batallas de orgullo derrochadoras o gastos ostentosos para vencer a los demás.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Convertir los estímulos competitivos externos únicamente en la fuerza motriz para fortalecer tus propias capacidades.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: Custodiando la Soberanía
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: Este año, renacerás como un líder subjetivo que controla perfectamente tu tiempo y tus recursos.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body:
El tema a largo plazo que recorre este año es establecer firmemente los límites de tu vida y recuperar completamente tu soberanía independiente. Entre demandas externas excesivas o luchas de poder, te darás cuenta claramente de qué valores necesitas proteger realmente.

Practicarás no dejarte influir por las miradas o la interferencia de los demás y usar tu precioso tiempo y energía enteramente para ti. La sabiduría de trazar una línea firme cuando debas negarte se adquirirá naturalmente.

Al organizar meticulosamente tu cerca a lo largo del año, completas una dignidad independiente que se yergue con orgullo ante la sacudida de los demás. Tendrás la emocionante experiencia de agarrar el volante de tu vida enteramente con tus propias manos.

No desperdiciar energía en relaciones innecesarias o tareas agotadoras es la clave del éxito este año. Concéntrate solo en ti y en tu crecimiento, y construye un muro interior sólido.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.watch_for: Enredarte en luchas de poder agotadoras y evitables, desperdiciando recursos.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Establecer límites claros y firmes para proteger tu energía y tus activos.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: El Maestro del Avance
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: A lo largo de este año, te convertirás en un pionero que rompe audazmente los límites y expande tu propio territorio.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body:
Este año es un año de crecimiento revolucionario en el que aprovechas al revés la tensión feroz y los entornos desafiantes para escribir tu propio mito. Rechazas la complacencia cómoda, te fijas estándares más altos y rompes los límites sin dudar.

Cada vez que te topes con situaciones estancadas o muros altos, demostrarás la audacia de usarlos como trampolín para un salto adelante. Cuando otros dudan, das un paso adelante y haces tuyo el territorio de nuevas posibilidades.

La tenacidad y la audacia firmemente establecidas a lo largo del año se convertirán en activos sin igual en el camino que recorrerás. La sensación de logro obtenida al atravesar el miedo de frente eleva tu autoestima al máximo.

No definas tus propios límites y sal audazmente a un mundo más amplio. Verás la magia de las ambiciones que duermen dentro de ti transformándose en logros masivos del mundo real.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.watch_for: Tomar decisiones imprudentes e impulsivas arrastrado por la impaciencia o la ansiedad.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Establecer metas elevadas y poner audazmente en acción tu impulso interior.

TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.name: The Spring of Abundant Creation
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.headline: This year, you will become a craftsman who creates freely according to your inner grain and enriches your daily life.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.body:
Throughout this year, your life will be filled with creative joy flowing naturally, not a struggle squeezed out by force. Based on your innate senses and expressive power, you will reveal yourself honestly and communicate warmly with the world.

You will fall deeply into the fun of molding ideas springing from deep within into concrete results in your daily life. True skill is demonstrated only when you focus entirely on your own taste and grain rather than conforming to others' standards.

Your unique brand and plans carefully cultivated over a year will bring abundant fruits over time. The creations you make will present fresh inspiration to those around you.

An attitude of cultivating your daily life like art with a relaxed mind brings great fortune. This year, leave a beautiful trace in the world at your own pace and rhythm.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.watch_for: Getting overly complacent in comfort and missing minimal discipline and schedules.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.lean_into: Concretizing your unique ideas and values into long-term projects.

TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.name: The Artist Who Enjoys Life
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.headline: This year, you will become someone who discovers the true value of abundance in the small joys of everyday life.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.body:
This year is a journey of breaking away from others' evaluations or performance-oriented pressure and polishing your life itself into a work of art. You will gain great inner peace by purely immersing yourself in what you love and carefully caring for your body and mind.

Even in a busy daily life, you will not miss small happiness, and you will recharge your energy through delicious food, good music, and warm conversations. This emotional richness creates a miracle that rather increases work efficiency.

Living with a sincere heart throughout the year reveals natural, late-blooming results in both work and life. You don't need to rush; the warm seeds you planted will bloom beautifully on their own.

You will realize how powerful an attitude of enjoying and comforting yourself is rather than whipping yourself. This year, your daily life itself becomes the most comfortable and wonderful sanctuary.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.watch_for: An attitude of postponing long-term goals by being drawn to short-term pleasure and comfort.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.lean_into: Building a lifestyle where sustainable rest and pure creation are in harmony.

TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.name: The Cultivator of Warm Value
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.headline: Throughout this year, you will become the subject who brightly illuminates the hearts of those around you with warmth and goodwill.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.body:
This year is a beautiful year where your warm sensitivity and generous sharing softly change the surrounding world. You will solidify an irreplaceable presence by sharing the joy you feel and useful knowledge with people.

People around you will gain great strength from the warm comfort and novel ideas you offer. You will experience a virtuous cycle where the goodwill you bestow circulates and returns to you as even greater luck.

The authenticity accumulated steadily like plowing a field over a year becomes the magic that enriches your entire life. Precious time continues where you feel true reward and happiness in people's smiles.

You will fully experience the essence of value that grows the more you share. This year is recorded as a year where your good influence breathes clear warmth into the world.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.watch_for: Neglecting minimal promises and systems under the guise of freedom.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.lean_into: Leaving your unique perspective and expression as continuous long-form content or works.

TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.name: The Icon of Innovation and Reform
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.headline: This year, you will grow into an innovator who breaks the stereotypes of the times and proposes a new paradigm.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.body:
This year is a year to boldly break the frustrating old frameworks and unreasonable customs of the past and present your unique vision to the world. You will be reborn as a proud protagonist who accurately grasps the inefficiencies others miss and presents groundbreaking alternatives.

You will throw sharp insights into stagnant organizations or old systems and lead the winds of change. Your sharp analysis and unstoppable execution will leave a deep impression on those around you.

The hot passion and persuasive power you will demonstrate throughout the year will completely change the landscape of the organization and the market. The feeling of a pioneer who does not fear change thrillingly fills your whole body.

Massive achievements are created when you pour your sense of justice and reform will into a constructive direction. This year is a glorious time when your voice becomes a powerful energy that changes the world.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.watch_for: Making enemies of your allies with excessively sharp and blunt remarks.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.lean_into: Leading groundbreaking projects that improve inefficient old structures.

TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.name: The Inspiring Spokesperson
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.headline: This year, you will become a star who captivates the public's heart with a confident voice and branding.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.body:
This year is a dynamic time when your sparkling aesthetic senses and genius expressive power receive the world's attention. You will effectively brand your inner beliefs and messages to present intense inspiration to people.

When you express your thoughts to the world without hesitation, countless people will fall for your charm. Your sense of reading trends becomes exceptionally sharp, maximizing your power to fascinate the public.

Throughout the year, confidently raising your voice to the world will let you experience taking center stage. Enjoy watching your name become a powerful brand.

There is no better time than now to imprint your unique style on the world. Bloom your talents fully under the brilliant spotlight.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.watch_for: Squandering energy on groundless criticism or rebellion simply to oppose the rules.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.lean_into: Pursuing a large-scale branding campaign to widely publicize your message.

TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.name: The Architect Who Sets a New Board
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.headline: Throughout this year, you will become someone who shakes off stagnant customs and creates a new path suited to the times.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.body:
This year unfolds a long-term narrative where you constructively reform old systems and lead people under a pioneering banner. You will recreate environments trapped in the swamp of convention with sharp insights and set new standards that draw admiration.

You seek better alternatives by questioning unconditional obedience or unreasonable practices. Your rational reform plan quenches the long thirst of those around you and breathes new vitality into them.

Your reform, added with consideration and wisdom, will open a new path of hope for many. You prove the qualifications of a true leader in the process of shaking off old legacies and designing a future-oriented framework.

Maximize the results of reform by persuading others with wise and soft communication. The new board you design this year will exert massive influence for years to come.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.watch_for: Showing impatient anger toward people who are slow or conservative.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.lean_into: Redesigning anachronistic procedures into modern and flexible systems.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.name: The Sailor Riding the Wave of Opportunity
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.headline: This year, you will be reborn as a dynamic planner who captures massive value amidst the waves of fierce change.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.body:
Throughout this year, you will be reborn as someone who flexibly captures the opportunities of a constantly moving world rather than staying in a fixed way. You will boldly expand your territory by recognizing undervalued possibilities that others cannot see at a glance.

You will intuitively read changes in the market and trends and attempt bold bets in the right place. The ever-changing environment itself becomes an exciting playground and a massive sea of opportunities for you.

The business agility and scalability demonstrated throughout the year elevate your lifestyle to a higher level. Profits and achievements generated from unexpected routes add vitality to your life.

The ability to keep various possibilities open and respond flexibly becomes your best weapon this year. Enjoy a heart-pounding adventure like a sailor enjoying the waves of change.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Taking on too many things at once and resulting in poor completion.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Expanding your territory by opening your mind to various possibilities and taking calculated risks.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.name: The Pioneer Crossing Boundaries
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.headline: This year, you will become a challenger who goes beyond existing domains and pioneers new pipelines.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.body:
This year is a time of three-dimensional growth, breaking out of familiar fences and pioneering new markets and fresh opportunities. You will draw unexpected results by agilely adapting to changes in situations and wittily combining idle resources.

You find fresh synergy points by crossing this and that field without being bound to one method. Your flexible mindset opens a powerful breakthrough in a stagnant daily life.

The diversified paths paved throughout the year will become solid assets to make your future fertile. The thrilling sense of achievement from new challenges fills your daily life with great excitement.

Embrace the boldness to throw off stereotyped thinking and advance into a vast land. Your challenging spirit this year will write a new success formula that the world takes notice of.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: A light attitude seeking only unverified speculative temptations or luck.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Flexibly attempting collaborations between different industries or new business models.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.name: The Magician of Resource Reallocation
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.headline: Throughout this year, you will become a tactician who maximizes hidden resources with a three-dimensional perspective.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.body:
This year unfolds a narrative of reconnecting stagnant assets and information with a creative eye and sublimating them into massive value. You will prove an excellent sense of turning any unexpected situation into an immediate opportunity.

You demonstrate outstanding ability to gather scattered networks, information, and material resources to create a valuable board. Even seemingly trivial things transform into massive added value through your hands.

Completing the massive spectrum you dreamed of comes when you explore the world with an open mind throughout the year. Your flexible and agile coping skills draw envy and admiration from those around you.

Widen your perspective on handling resources and attempt bold matching. The tact you demonstrate this year will bring you both practical rewards and honor.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Being blinded by short-term profits and neglecting long-term substance and basics.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Diversifying new value creation channels with a flexible and open attitude.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.name: The Architect of a Solid Castle
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.headline: This year, you will become someone who accumulates irreplaceable solid assets through silent discipline and faithfulness.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.body:
The narrative running through this year is the faithfulness of excluding luck and steadily stacking practical towers day by day. Realistic senses and precise management skills shine, establishing a stable and unshakable foundation.

Your attitude of unswervingly keeping the established principles and routines without being shaken by immediate temptations shines. The meticulousness that does not allow a single margin of error firmly protects your finances and career.

The system carefully established over a year will present you with a deep sense of stability that will not collapse for a lifetime. The practically accumulated achievements put solid strength on your shoulders.

A glorious time unfolds proving that consistency is the fastest way. The realistic foundation you build this year becomes a sturdy fortress supporting all future challenges.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Blocking opportunities for fresh change due to excessively conservative attitudes.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Standardizing core routines and asset management systems to promote compound growth.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.name: The Guardian of Honest Value
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.headline: This year, you will become a figure who perfectly fulfills your duties and receives deep respect and trust.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.body:
This year is a time when the noble power of honesty and consistency is most clearly proven in your life. You will establish a solid position in the organization and society by perfectly managing seemingly trivial daily promises and tasks.

Your attitude of proving trust through actions rather than words gives deep inspiration to those around you. Your appearance of silently completing tasks without avoiding responsibility anywhere leads to the best reputation.

The reputation accumulated over the year returns as a massive asset that cannot be exchanged for anything. People believe in your gravity and faithfulness and willingly entrust important tasks to you.

It will be a rewarding year confirming the truth that honest sweat does not betray. A brilliant crown of trust is placed on every step you take walking straight while keeping principles.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Excessively obsessing over small indicators or details and tiring yourself out.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Precisely organizing the substance of life and accumulating the fruits of honest achievement.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.name: The Master of Compounding
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.headline: Throughout this year, you will achieve silent but overwhelming growth within an organized system.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.body:
This year is a year to correct the disorder of daily life and gradually accumulate massive achievements on top of solid basics. You will create a solid substance by deeply immersing yourself in things you can control without being bound by uncertainty.

You will experience the magic of compounding that swells like a snowball over time by systematically managing small habits and assets. Unflashy but substantial growth creates explosive synergy.

Where you stand after a year will be incomparably solid and calm than before. The unshakable daily system brings massive wealth and stability to you.

Demonstrate the wisdom of focusing on small daily advancements, throwing away impatience. The tower of success that will last a lifetime is completed on the solid foundation you laid this year.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: An attitude of evaluating your entire value solely by immediate results or numbers.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Building healthy habits and practical foundations that are sustainable in the long run.

TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.name: The Protagonist of a Heroic Leap
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.headline: This year, you will become a leader who passes through harsh ordeals head-on and achieves a massive reversal.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.body:
The long-term narrative running through this year is a hero's journey of crossing a massive mountain with courage and determination and finally achieving victory. You reveal your hidden strong spirit by directly accepting high-difficulty challenges and heavy responsibilities you wanted to avoid.

You shine even more on the frontline where others want to run away, turning fierce pressure into opportunities. Your bold determination and drive become a savior that rescues the organization in times of crisis.

Having completed the training of the year, you will be a solid hero who maintains calmness in any crisis. You will face a more mature self, wearing the harsh trials like medals.

Break through this year's tasks head-on with the heart of a lion fighting fear. The sweat you shed will be completed as the most dramatic narrative of success.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.watch_for: Overworking your mind and body or pushing others by obsessing too much over achieving goals.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.lean_into: Breaking through high-difficulty tasks head-on based on bold responsibility.

TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.name: Training Through the Crucible
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.headline: This year, you will be reborn as an inner master by using harsh pressure as the best nutrient.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.body:
This year is a year of boldness to burn away your weaknesses and fears and complete an iron-hard character. You achieve a different level of performance by demonstrating amazing concentration in situations that demand high responsibility.

The pressure and stress tightening from all sides rather become a crucible that pulls your potential to the extreme. You coolly smash the massive walls you didn't dare to imagine before.

The solid confidence established over a year will firmly protect you against any storm. Like steel that has gone through harsh quenching, your inner self possesses a firmness that no one can break.

Experience the trials head-on without avoiding them and absorb the inner strength. The fierce pain of this year becomes a sacred foundation for tomorrow's most brilliant glory.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.watch_for: Taking excessively defensive or aggressive attitudes toward external stimuli.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.lean_into: Reversing the most difficult challenges into the best stepping stones for your growth.

TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.name: The Decision That Changes the Board
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.headline: Throughout this year, you will completely resolve long-cherished tasks that were tangled with excellent determination.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.body:
This year is a year to cut away long-stagnant problems with a single decision and open a new horizon. You show the boldness to focus all your energy on essential values without being swayed by personal feelings.

You completely overturn the board through bold restructuring and decisions, like cutting a complex tangled knot with a single knife. Your charisma, which puts concerns around you to rest in one blow, reaches its peak.

The dignified and bold leadership you will show throughout the year will leave a deep imprint on those around you. The results pushed forward with determination make your position solid like a natural fortress.

Swing the sharp blade that cuts off lingering attachments and aims at the core. The bold decision you make this year completely turns the flow of your life toward victory.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.watch_for: Continuing to drive yourself like an emergency without enough rest and getting exhausted.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.lean_into: Boldly organizing unnecessary tasks and focusing on the most essential tasks.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.name: The Guardian of Noble Principles
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.headline: This year, you will become someone who rises to a honorable rank with correct procedures and high character.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.body:
Throughout this year, you will establish official authority and trust based on upright character and correct principles. You will receive the voluntary respect and support of many people by maintaining transparent communication and fair attitudes.

Your appearance of uprightly keeping principles without seeking luck or using expedient methods gives a great resonance to those around. Your upright attitude itself becomes a compass that straightens the discipline of the organization and raises its dignity.

The reputation and honor dignifiedly established over a year will become a solid crown for your career. You enjoy the joy of rapidly rising social status by taking official titles or positions.

Move forward toward noble honor with high morality and responsibility as weapons. The principled footsteps you set this year become a brilliant legacy that serves as an example for others for a long time.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.watch_for: Being excessively tied to others' gazes or social evaluations and losing freedom.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.lean_into: Establishing official position and authority by keeping high ethical standards and procedures.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.name: The Cornerstone of Trust
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.headline: This year, you will establish yourself as an indispensable solid pillar in the community you belong to.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.body:
This year is a time to establish organized order and clear standards, giving great relief to the organization and family. You prove an irreplaceable presence in the process of strictly keeping promises and flawlessly fulfilling your duties.

The place where you are itself becomes a safe zone, and those around you lean on your solidity and enjoy peace. Your neat and exemplary attitude healthily sustains the entire community.

The deep stability rooted throughout the year makes you the teacher and support that those around you rely on the most. You take charge of the central axis of the community as a key figure no one can deny.

Create a sustainable order by building a systematic and transparent process. A more solid and brilliant building of success rises on the cornerstone you laid this year.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.watch_for: Suffering from excessive stress trapped in the framework of self-imposed obligations and discipline.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.lean_into: Building transparent and systematic guidelines to create a sustainable order.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.name: The Architect of Harmonious Order
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.headline: Throughout this year, you will lead solid peace and success by harmonizing principles and consideration.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.body:
This year is a year to meticulously organize ambiguous roles and systems and complete an optimal environment where everyone can coexist. Your dignity of taking legitimate procedures without seeking luck bears fruit as the best achievement.

You achieve perfect harmony by adding warm embrace and a sense of balance rather than just holding up a strict standard. You build an ideal system where rules and humanity beautifully blend.

After a year, your life will enjoy deep peace within a neat and elegant order. The chaotic surrounding environment perfectly regains stability thanks to your organized touch.

Demonstrate wise leadership that keeps principles but embraces people. The harmonious order you complete this year becomes the most elegant castle of success that will not collapse for a lifetime.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.watch_for: A mind that delays decision-making or becomes impatient due to excessive perfectionism.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.lean_into: Laying the foundation for receiving clear recognition, such as official contracts or certifications.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.name: The Insight of Deep Penetration
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: This year, you will become a sage who penetrates the truth hidden behind phenomena and draws the blueprint of the times.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.body:
Throughout this year, you will take a step back from the noise of the noisy world and refine unique wisdom and sharp insight. You will complete an original long-term strategy by grasping the deep principles and patterns of events that others cannot see.

Your eyes to penetrate the great flow of the times and the essence without being swayed by immediate phenomena open brilliantly. The realization gained through deep contemplation and research completely differentiates your perspective.

The wisdom matured deeply inside over a year will become a brilliant milestone on the path you will walk. Original philosophies and plans that the world will admire are born in your head at this time.

Enjoy quiet reading and contemplation and expand your inner universe. The sharp insight you refine this year becomes the most powerful weapon of your life for years to come.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Delaying practical execution by obsessing too much over thoughts and analysis.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Completing conceptual thoughts into precise strategic reports or original frameworks.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.name: The Fusion of Intuition and Wisdom
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: This year, you will trust your sharp inner intuition and bloom a higher level of originality in the world.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.body:
This year is a year when accumulated experience and deep intuition combine perfectly to draw amazing intellectual insight. You will clearly solve complex tangled tasks with humanistic and strategic approaches that others cannot easily think of.

Intuitive inspiration that transcends the limits of logic flashes, and you find the answers to difficult problems at once. Your unique perspective and deep interpretation skills draw admiration from those around you.

Listening to your inner voice throughout the year completes your one and only wisdom in the world. Your unique expertise and philosophy leave a clear mark on the world.

Trust the voice of intuition ringing inside you and immerse yourself in deep learning. The intellectual achievements you build this year become noble spiritual assets that cannot be bought anywhere.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: A tendency to cut off communication with others and isolate yourself too much in your own world.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Securing your own original expertise through deep research and contemplation.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.name: The Strategist Who Reads the Future
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: Throughout this year, you will become someone who opens new opportunities and dimensions of life through deep contemplation.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.body:
This year is a deep year to broaden the horizon of knowledge, explore the essential principles of life, and achieve mental maturity. You will read the flow of the world in advance and complete a high-dimensional blueprint through quiet time of contemplation alone.

You newly design the board of life with a macroscopic eye that looks several steps ahead rather than chasing immediate profits. The future-oriented vision you draw presents amazing inspiration to those around you.

The sharp insight established over a year becomes a lighthouse that finds a way even in any crisis. Thanks to excellent insight that seems to predict the future, every choice bears accurate and shining fruit.

Take time to escape from the noise of the world and immerse yourself in deep thought and research. The massive master plan you establish this year becomes a solid compass to guide your lifelong life.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Behaving in overly abstract fantasies while ignoring realistic conditions.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Accumulating wisdom that penetrates the times through professional study or deep contemplation.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.name: Abundant Recharge and Acceptance
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: This year, you will become someone who completes powerful inner strength through sacred rest and learning.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.body:
The long-term narrative running through this year is to recover the fundamental physical strength of life through deep acceptance and recharging. You will have time to absorb the teacher's wisdom and extremely comfort your tired body and mind rather than running out breathlessly.

The internal capabilities filled step by step over a year become the strongest root supporting the leap to the next stage. Put an elegant comma in your life that has been running without rest and enjoy complete recovery.

An attitude of letting go of impatience and absorbing wisdom with a humble heart brings the best luck. The sacred rest and charging you enjoy this year become a massive driving force for explosive growth before long.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Losing the will to lead and execute on your own by settling for excessive comfort.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Humbly learning the mentor's wisdom and focusing on perfect recovery and internal recharging.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.name: The Wise Beneficiary
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: This year, you will achieve complete rest and growth with the support of warm helpers.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.body:
This year is a cozy time to humbly accept the precious help and support around you and deepen your inner self. You will learn how to treat yourself preciously through verified learning and mentoring, breaking away from a life of struggling alone.

You meet a reliable mentor or benefactor who cherishes and supports you and gain precious lessons of life. You find peace of mind by breaking away from the obsession that you must solve everything with your own hands.

Having absorbed abundant love and wisdom over a year, you will be a giant tree that gives comfort to those around you. You achieve safe and certain growth within the warm fence of helpers.

Demonstrate the virtue of acceptance by fully accepting love and support. The affectionate care and learning you enjoy this year become the warmest and most reliable lifeline supporting your life.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Losing independence and autonomy by relying too much on others' support.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Building an optimal learning environment and a solid recovery routine just for you.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.name: Completion of the Inner Sanctuary
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: Throughout this year, you will be reborn as a wise teacher with unshakable inner resilience.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.body:
This year is a peaceful year to return to the inner sanctuary, heal the tired soul, and compile know-how accumulated over a long time. You will prioritize deep stability of body and mind and organize your thoughts neatly through learning.

You build a peaceful sanctuary by blocking complex external noises and focusing solely on deep communion with yourself. You enjoy the blessing of your learning and experiences being organized into a perfect system in your head.

After a year, your inner self will be full of deep wisdom and cozy confidence that does not shake in any storm. The experience of completely healing and comforting yourself makes you a teacher who exerts good influence on others.

Organize your knowledge and firmly cultivate the sanctuary of your heart. The quiet and solid inner sanctuary you complete this year becomes the most glorious refuge protecting you for a lifetime.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.watch_for: Complacency that keeps postponing actual challenges under the pretext of perfect preparation.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Systematically organizing knowledge into manuals and assets for future generations.

DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.name: El Año en Desarrollo
DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.headline: Un año que aún toma forma.
DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.body: La energía de este año es difícil de reducir a un solo patrón. Presta atención — el tema se revelará a medida que avances.
DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.watch_for: Asumir que ya sabes de qué trata este año.
DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.lean_into: Mantener la curiosidad sobre lo que realmente está sucediendo.

SOLAR_CALENDAR_NOTE: El año de arriba sigue el calendario de términos solares (Lichun a Lichun). En enero, el año solar anterior aún está activo.
